goal: Current-version real DeepSeek Compile and Refine validation of upstream business invariants; preserve language-independent behavior rather than Python implementation details.

runtime_requirements.note: This design manifest does not authorize, perform, or claim any network call by itself; the root task has user authorization to execute acceptance.

global_assertions.publication: Validate final Document with the selected profile, independently compile it with h3, and require Artifact prompt/manifest/hash equality. Encode/decode the Document and reproduce the same artifact. A compiled status alone is insufficient.
global_assertions.accounting: Retain stage/system/input/schema/output, model identity, ordered attempts, errors and token usage for every actual call. Report first-attempt and repaired outcomes separately. No transport retry, model switch or hidden draft fallback.
global_assertions.media_graph: Every final reference, subject source and prompt media label resolves to an attached asset and manifest entry; every media use has the matching source identity, role, retention and target use. No phantom IDs or dangling bindings.
global_assertions.literal_channels: Caller-fixed dialogue remains byte-for-byte in the strict typed performance channel and continuity contract. Visible text preserves exact word bytes in the authorized typed display events and requested shots, with no extra typed lettering. Repeated prose describing the same prop/display is not another display merely because the final prompt repeats its string; independent semantic review must still reject extra signs or unauthorized readable carry into another shot. Match actual final Document and rendered text.
global_assertions.observational_boundary: Observed attributes, caller-required changes and creative additions retain distinct provenance. A supplied Card is explicit observation input, never evidence of a fresh audio/video/vision inference.
global_assertions.timing: All shots/events/dialogue runs lie within the actual target duration and use valid ordered intervals. Pinned cuts/shots survive; frame policy and computed duration are recorded rather than silently rounded.
global_assertions.choice_preservation: Explicit mode, declared roles, reference identities, target graph choices, transcript selections and caller constraints survive unless a later caller amendment explicitly changes them.
global_assertions.semantic_review: Review the final prose against the original requested entities, actions, spatial/temporal order and evidence. Do not use the same model response as its own semantic oracle; record concrete pass/fail evidence and unresolved findings.

cost_control.recommendation: Run the 6 suite plus 3 highlevel cases first, then all 16 declared-role cases. Added combinations and 4 Refine chains close gaps. Do not replay old model bytes as fresh current-version evidence. If code changes, rerun every affected live case; explicitly label unaffected earlier-revision results.
cost_control.note: Final executor declares 3/3 finite repairs explicitly; core library defaults are unchanged. The original wardrobe reproduction intentionally preserves its original comfy profile and 1/1 repair options. Every failed attempt and usage stays recorded.

real_png_live_observation.claim: Actual on-disk PNG bytes sent to the explicitly configured image-capable service, resulting in fresh metered observations.
real_png_live_observation.limit: Does not establish audio/video perception or H3 video generation quality. If the selected DeepSeek endpoint rejects images, report this separately and do not silently substitute supplied Cards.

supplied_typed_observation.claim: Fresh real text-model interpretation and compilation against explicitly supplied observation Cards.
supplied_typed_observation.limit: Not fresh visual/acoustic/video inference, even when the source test names an audio/video asset.

text_only_live.claim: Fresh real text-model interpretation and final artifact publication, no media perception.

controlled_boundary_fault.claim: An explicitly introduced invalid response/provider failure tests boundary behavior; a subsequent retry may be a real model call.
controlled_boundary_fault.limit: The injected failure is not a naturally occurring DeepSeek failure.
